title: Water content of light n-alkanes: new measurements and cubic-plus-association equation of state modeling
authors: Mohsen Zirrahi, Hassan Hassanzadeh, Jalal Abedi
needs_pass2_reason: text layer clean; all 62 cells x3 columns matched the 200 dpi page image
experimental_method: Bubble column in an oven saturates the gas with water; after a demister the gas is cooled, water adsorbed on a desiccant and weighed, dried gas volume measured by a gasometer.
uncertainties_stated: Uncertainty of data less than 6 % of reported values; oven temperature accuracy +-1 C; gasometer accuracy 0.2 % of reading range; each experiment repeated at least twice and the average reported.
quality_remarks: Abstract and title mention butane/n-alkanes including n-butane in the modelling, but Table A1 contains only methane, ethane, propane (the text says the apparatus was used to measure methane, ethane and propane). Publication year: online 2016, volume year 2017. Pressure basis and temperature scale not stated.
